family.description: This is the C-terminal domain found in NF-kappa-B-activating protein (Nkap) and a hypothetical open reading frame on chromosome 6, c6orf194. Functional studies in Nkap indicate that this domain is the HDAC3 binding domain and is required for transcriptional repression [[cite:PUB00075800]]. Nkap functions as a transcriptional repressor on Notch target genes, and is required for T cell development and acquisition of functional competency [[cite:PUB00075800],[cite:PUB00075801],[cite:PUB00075802]].
family.name: NF-kappa-B-activating protein C-terminal domain
